title: sparkainlp-x: Distributed Trifold Arena and Synthetic Multi-Agent Network Diagnostics
description:
Open-source synthetic research software for deterministic multi-agent arena diagnostics, aerospace synchronization, energy phase-field surrogates, trifold membrane states, and bounded network aggregation.

The v4.1.0 release includes three explicit membrane phases, 9+2 observer-proxy calibration, wormhole and bridge diagnostics, timestamp-free SHA-256 provenance, private seeded random-number generation, and regression-tested multi-agent execution.

These modules are computational testbenches. They do not claim physical wormhole formation, spacetime manipulation, spacecraft control, validated materials behavior, empathy measurement, or human-welfare outcomes.
notes: Release tag: v4.1.0. Three-node seed-42 audit artifact SHA-256: fd2ec54e253aa8ac858a4c9784bc8c754d79507c7a53a0deaac12a921c89656e. Audit provenance SHA-256: 243a7c08922bac04972ef610eca998880e2963a828f484ed6b8ca2d0271d7019. The multi-agent bridge label is retained for compatibility, while the implementation is explicitly classified as bounded synthetic aggregation.
